name: Aviation Control: Runway Allocation Protocol
description: 滑走路割り当てプロトコルにおける競合状態をZ3が検出し、ロック順序と不変条件で安全性を検証するデモ

intro: Step 1: LLM generates runway allocation code...
Step 2: mumei verifies mutual exclusion and deadlock freedom...
narrative.before: allocate_runway 関数がロック順序を無視し、デッドロックの可能性
narrative.after: 順序付けられたロックと不変条件で修正し、相互排除をZ3で検証

rejected.headline: BUG DETECTED! Potential deadlock in runway allocation
follow_up: Lock acquisition order is not consistent across flights.
Two flights could deadlock waiting for each other's runways.
Step 3: Verifying the ordered lock implementation...

pass.headline: Z3 verified mutual exclusion and deadlock freedom
follow_up: No two flights can hold the same runway simultaneously.
Ordered lock acquisition prevents circular wait.

steps.name: Z3 Bug Detection: unordered lock acquisition
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the expected rejection diagnostic.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 1 and emits expected rejection evidence (InvalidPreState).

steps.name: Z3 Correct Runway Allocation Verification
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the verifier gate evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Verification passed, allocate_runway).

steps.name: Agent Aviation Control Forge Dry Run
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the agent gate evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (no required output marker).

harness_contract.intent: Prove runway allocation uses ordered locking and preserves mutual exclusion/deadlock-freedom evidence.
artifact_contracts: Generate evidence: result.json and report.md in reports/{scenario}/latest/ plus per-step logs.
result.json records lock-order rejection, correct Z3 acceptance, and agent dry-run.
report.md explains the runway allocation before/after evidence.
The L1 gate has no standalone proof certificate; result.json and logs are the verification evidence.
dashboard/summary.md aggregates PASS and proof-density evidence for the scenario.
Gate order: l1_z3 -> l2_agent; each stage must satisfy its expected_exit, expected_patterns, artifacts, and depends_on contract before downstream evidence is trusted.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Runway allocation must prevent circular wait and concurrent runway ownership.
success_criteria: unordered allocation is rejected with InvalidPreState.
Agent dry-run validates vstd_aviation_control task after L1 acceptance.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Medium: no separate proof certificate is emitted, so logs/result.json remain the primary evidence.
